messages.subject: lavaan.survey reporting TLI > 3 (comparing to Mplus)
parts:
Hi-- I have a question using lavaan.survey. I am running a basic path model using weights.

I am also comparing results derived using Mplus (using the same model specifications). The parameter estimates are the same and the standard errors are similar (to the second decimal place) so the model is being run correctly. 

However, I just have a question regarding the Chi square and TLI statistics. In lavaan.survey, I am getting a TLI > 3 (see below). Also, the chi square is off compared to what I am getting in Mplus (using MLR). The scaling correction factors seem quite different. Also, the Robust TLI > 5 which seems odd. 

Any ideas why a discrepancy might exist? 

Thank you.

messages.subject: Re: lavaan.survey reporting TLI > 3 (comparing to Mplus)
parts:
That smells like either a bug, or a numerical issue (a non-positive
matrix somewhere). If you are able to send me a reproducible script
(perhaps with a snippet of the data), I will try to find out where it
goes wrong.

Yves.
